# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-sixties  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Rank:** Landowner / Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angular features and dark hair showing gray streaks, which she twirls into a hard knot behind her head. Her face bears a grim expression that is occasionally softened by a twitched mouth indicating an understated sense of humor. Over time, her gaunt, angular figure softens in face and expression, though her hair remains twisted in its signature tight knot.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c34 P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and firm principles who values order, neatness, and duty above all else. Though outwardly strict, crisp, and undemonstrative, she hides a deep warmth, maternal tenderness, and an underlying sense of humor. She holds strongly to her convictions and can be stubborn, yet she possesses the humility to admit her mistakes and soften her sternness when guided by love.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c14 P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)_

## Traits

- Strict and disciplined  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001)</sub>
- Meticulously neat and precise  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c3 P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne Shirley and the Keith twins into proper, useful adults  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>
- To preserve and maintain Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P27](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0027)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived a quiet, solitary life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew until they decided to adopt an orphan boy to assist on the farm. By a mistake in the message, an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley, was brought to them instead. Although Marilla initially intended to return the child, she was persuaded by Matthew's silent persistence and her own growing pity to keep her. Over the years, Marilla conscientiously undertook Anne's upbringing, attempting to curb her wild imagination and garrulous nature while secretly falling deeply in love with her. When Matthew died suddenly, Marilla faced the prospect of selling Green Gables due to her failing eyesight, but Anne gave up her college scholarship to stay and help her. Marilla's eyes later improved sufficiently to avert blindness, and she took in her distant relative's orphaned twins, Davy and Dora Keith, as well as her lifelong friend Mrs. Rachel Lynde, after the death of Thomas Lynde. Years later, Marilla joyfully gave her consent and blessing to Anne's marriage to Gilbert Blythe, opening Green Gables to its very first wedding.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P33](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0033), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v4 c2 P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Avonlea at Green Gables by her parents  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with John Blythe which ended in an unforgiven quarrel  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Lived a quiet, unmarried life with her brother Matthew at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037)</sub>

> When I make up my mind to do a thing it stays made up.  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

> I didn’t trouble my head about getting pretty dresses for you. I don’t believe in pampering vanity, Anne, I’ll tell you that right off.  <sub>[v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008)</sub>
